payload.credit_html: "A new herrerasaurian dinosaur from the Upper Triassic Upper Maleri Formation of south-central India"
payload.description_html: Preserved bones of Maleriraptor kuttyi (holotype, ISIR 282). (a) Reconstruction of the skeleton of Maleriraptor kuttyi (drawn by M.S.G.) showing the preserved bones in colour. (b) Photograph of the holotype specimen of Maleriraptor kuttyi in approximate articulation.
